title: FounderX (Founder Institute, Oakland + SF) — Eric on 'AI companies that do not lose themselves on the way up'
summary: The Founder Institute ran its Global FounderX Conference from 25 to 27 August, the first two days at 1900 Broadway Tower and STAK Space in Oakland and the third at Step San Francisco. Eric was one of its speakers.
blockquote:
At FounderX, Eric joins the conversation on the future of startups and what it takes to build AI companies that do not lose themselves on the way up.

August 25-27, STAK Space and Step San Francisco.
attribution_title: Global FounderX Conference, Aug 25–27 · Oakland (STAK Space) + Step San Francisco
